parent_objective: design conservative medium PPO escalation under expanded public proof gates
blocked_by: M1066 admits medium PPO design but not a PPO run
invalidates: running medium PPO without pre-registered expanded gates and rollback rules

public_gates: M1067 must not use private holdout
M1067 must design medium PPO with expanded exact proof family-intersection source-diverse fresh/OOD and behavior gates
forbidden_shortcuts: do not relax M1061 family-intersection gate for medium PPO

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_training: medium PPO under expanded proof gates
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the first conservative medium PPO escalation after proof surface refresh and gate integration
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: PPO design only; no PPO, no actor training, no promotion, no medium-run claim
stop_condition: stop if medium PPO design cannot include expanded proof gates
stop if rollback conditions are underspecified
stop if design would use private holdout
fallback_plan: if design is accepted, route to a single-seed medium PPO run with no promotion
if gate cost is too high, route to runtime audit before training
if rollback rules are unclear, route to proof gate threshold audit
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1066 admits conservative medium PPO design

hypothesis: A conservative medium PPO escalation can be safely pre-registered using the expanded public gate stack before any training run.
success_criteria: design names base checkpoint config step count seed and run directories
design names exact public replay M1061 family-intersection source-diverse fresh/OOD and behavior gates
design states rollback conditions and promotion is blocked
no PPO actor training promotion or private holdout occurs
decision_rule: M1067 may only design the conservative medium PPO escalation. It cannot run PPO, train actor, promote, or use private holdout.
